images.caption: On September 16, 2007, a Boeing MD-82, operated by One-Two-Go Airlines crashed during an attempted landing and missed approach at Phuket International Airport, Phuket, Thailand. There were 88 fatalities among the 130 people on board.  Heavy rain was reported at the time of the accident.  An NTSB accredited representative and technical advisors from the FAA, Boeing, and Pratt&Whitney travelled to assist with the investigation.
